question: The 'Secular' word in the Indian Constitution was added to the constitution by ________ Constitutional Amendment Act.
solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd Constitutional Amendment Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Secular'** was added to the Indian Constitution through the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976**.
 
• This amendment inserted the terms **'Secular'** and **'Socialist'** into the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The term **'Secular'** signifies that the Indian state has no official religion and treats all religions equally, ensuring freedom of religion for all citizens.
 
• The amendment was introduced during the tenure of **Prime Minister Indira Gandhi**.
 
• The 42nd Amendment is often referred to as the **“Mini-Constitution”** due to the extensive changes it brought to the Constitution.
 
• It also added provisions related to the **Fundamental Duties** in Part IV-A of the Constitution (Article 51A).
 
• The amendment aimed to strengthen the principles of **democracy, equality, and justice** as enshrined in the Constitution.
 
• It also made significant changes to the **structure of the judiciary**, the powers of the central and state governments, and the Directive Principles of State Policy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **44th Constitutional Amendment Act**__

 __
 
• The **44th Amendment** was enacted in **1978** to undo some of the changes made by the 42nd Amendment.
 
• It restored the **original emphasis on fundamental rights** and curtailed the powers of the executive during emergencies.
 
• This amendment ensured that **Article 21 (Right to Life and Personal Liberty)** cannot be suspended even during a national emergency.
 
 
 
• **46th Constitutional Amendment Act**__
 __
 
• The **46th Amendment**, enacted in **1982**, dealt with issues related to **sales tax** on goods and services.
 
• It included a wide range of transactions within the ambit of the term **'sale of goods'** to enable states to levy sales tax on them.
 
 
 
• **48th Constitutional Amendment Act**__
 
 
• The **48th Amendment** was passed in **1984** to extend the President's Rule in the state of **Punjab** beyond one year.
 
• This was done in the context of the prevailing situation in Punjab due to the rise of **insurgency and militancy**.
